programme.desc: Eastern pearls for his daughter lead tycoon Wang Daqian to tragedy: the girl and lover Suo Ying die in an inn the same night. Suo Ying is still en route, while husband Lin Yanwu—present at the scene—turns himself in.

programme.title: Judge Shi: The Case Of The Eastern Pearls
programme.desc: Eastern pearls for his daughter lead tycoon Wang Daqian to tragedy: the girl and lover Suo Ying die in an inn the same night. Suo Ying is still en route, while husband Lin Yanwu—present at the scene—turns himself in.

programme.title: The Chivalrous Constable: A Game of Chess
Yuan Tiangang and the Red Flame of Luo yang
Met At Luanfeng Corridor Bridge
programme.desc: Boat-born orphan Qu Mei washes ashore after typhoon, loses cliff-falling husband, yet raises sons to college on hillside taro.

programme.title: Detective W
programme.desc: Several people fought for a precious diamond ring. Among them there were local villains, a successful business person, as well as mysterious people… Eventually justice defeated evil.

programme.title: Fire-line Fighting: Defense for lnnocence
programme.desc: A story of solving a murder in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Real Swordsman
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, Zhou Wu, a villain, was beaten by a swordswoman and lost his memory. People cheated him by telling him that he was a swordsman instead of a villain. Zhou Wu believed and decided to fight against the head of a gangster, Xiashanhu.

programme.title: Heroic Shadows of Chang'an: The Bizarre Case of the Medicine King
The Commitment
programme.desc: Maizi's husband was injured during an accident when working in a colliery. He became paralyzed, and Maizi had to make her choice about her future.

programme.title: Er Zi Has a Little Hotel
programme.desc: Er Zi has no job. One day his friend Ma Gan learned that they could contract for a little hotel and came to discuss this idea with Er Zi. Er Zi was happy and began to find other partners.Ying Zi and Xiao Dou were persuaded by him and decided to join.

programme.title: Bodyguards for the Han Family
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, a righteous general was framed and killed. His soldiers volunteered to serve as bodyguards for his widow as well as her family to escort their escape.

programme.title: Detective Zhang Yugui 3: The Law Enforcer
Han Zhongli And The Tyrant'S Comeuppance
programme.desc: The eight immortals of Chinese legend roam the mortal world righting wrongs. With magic, music and laughter they punish corrupt tyrants, aid the helpless and expose greed, proving justice needs no crown-only courage and a good heart.

programme.title: Doubao Magistrate
programme.desc: Magistrate Dou Bao risks his life to save an old man who claims to be his real father, turning the house upside-down. When countless homeless elders seek help, Dou raises funds and treats the impostor with filial devotion.

programme.title: Two People Under the Same Roof
programme.desc: A couple divorces but still lives together in a house divided between them until one of them contracts an incurable disease.

programme.title: Strangers
programme.desc: Two strangers meet on a London-bound train and decide to help one another by killing each other's wives.

programme.title: Threads of Time
programme.desc: Facing death with weary grace, courtesan-poet Liu Rushi tells her daughter how she seized choice in a world that bought and sold women: naming herself, daring to love scholar-official Qian Qianyi, defying dynastic collapse and choosing simple truth.

programme.title: Jin Guilan
programme.desc: Jin Guilan is an outstanding judge. She works hard and has solved 1,050 cases. Her diligence, warm heart, intelligence as well as righteous personality have won her a good reputation among ordinary people and have had a positive influence in society.

programme.title: Shi Jin the Nine-Tattooed Hero: Eliminating Evil in Shijia Village
programme.desc: Shi Jin, the chivalrous master of Shi Manor, earns seven green dragon tattoos from his martial arts mentors; after an eighth treacherous master nearly ruins his family, mentor Wang Jin saves him, helping Shi Jin slay his foe and get his ninth tattoo.

programme.title: Spicy Girl
programme.desc: Caiyun is ambitious, innovative and eager to achieve her goal. While she grew up in a remote village, she tried various times to alleviate poverty: she raised deer and grew grapes.

programme.title: My Daddy My King
programme.desc: Li Guofu and his son Pingwa lived together. Pingwa was about to reach thirty years old, but he was unable to properly solve issues independently. Pingwa refused to receive Li Guofu's help and was on bad terms with him.

programme.title: The Women Volleyball Player
programme.desc: Sha Ou, a Chinese female volleyball player, was determined to become a top athlete. She trained hard and eventually the Chinese women's volleyball team defeated the Japanese team and became the champion.
